goal: Schritt 1: echten Chromium-Interaktionslauf bei 1440x900 durchführen und einen reproduzierbaren visuellen Befund minimal beheben. Schritt 2 nach grünem Zwischen-Gate: denselben Slice bei 200-%-Zoom-Äquivalent, sichtbarem Fokus und ohne horizontalen Overflow prüfen; nur bei reproduzierbarem Befund minimal korrigieren.

guide_delta.summary: Der reale Browserlauf bestätigte Auswahl, Tastaturplatzierung, Rasterblockade und 200-%-Bedienbarkeit. Ein sichtbarer alter Leerhinweis wurde mit einer einzelnen CSS-Regel korrigiert; Schritt 2 benötigte keinen weiteren Fix.

direct_dependencies: five-iteration screenshot milestone rule in AGENTS.md
tests_required: Step 1: palette keyboard selection and arrow-key target navigation
Step 1: valid Enter placement and deterministic preview
Step 1: invalid full-width right-edge placement blocked
Step 1: empty-state hidden after successful placement
Step 1: no horizontal overflow, browser console errors or page errors
Step 1: targeted browser-shell compile and regression tests
Step 2: visible focus outline at least 3px
Step 2: no horizontal overflow and interaction remains usable
Step 2: final targeted UI and repository-foundation gates
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because the change is isolated to the browser mask-builder shell
database regressions because no database dependency or route is introduced
template-store tests because persistence remains out of scope
risks: real-browser screenshots are represented in the repository by machine evidence and cryptographic hashes rather than committed binary previews
vertical scrolling at 200 percent is expected while horizontal overflow must remain absent
no persistent template semantics are introduced
non_changes: no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
expected_side_effects: the stale empty-state label disappears after the first valid placement
I100 records auditable real-Chromium interaction and 200-percent accessibility evidence
